title: Page 9
content_zh:
“那路老爷话不多，待我和大堂哥不错，我回来前他还特地指点我一些做生意的门道，他在得知我以后想出海去见识见识，还说可以介绍一个经验老道又靠得住的海商给我……”

听到这里，孔氏拧了下儿子的耳朵，“你这个小子还想出海去，想找死啊，你娘我可没答应，不许给我去。”

寒得福揉着耳朵，急忙解释，“哎，娘，现下海船造得极为坚固，何况路老爷说那海商经验老道，不会有危险，我该趁着年轻出去闯闯，也好长长见识。”

寒仲文在一颔首，替儿子说了几句话，“得福说得没错，孩子大了不能老把他拘在这小山里，让他出去见世面也是好的。”

见丈夫发话，孔氏横了儿子一眼，接着问：“这路家除了路老爷、路少东家，还有什么人呢？”

“路家人丁不多，除了路老爷和路挽风，家里还有一个母亲，也是个慈祥和善的人，对咱们招可是疼得紧，两人就像亲祖孙似的，每日里有说不完的话。”

听完儿子所说，寒仲文脸色缓和许多。

孔氏则十分满意，“这么说来，这路家人口简单，待咱们招财也很不错。”

寒得福颔首，“是呀，原先我也不太赞成招财嫁进路家，不过在那儿住两天之后，便觉得妹妹能嫁进路家也不是坏事，虽然离咱们杏花村远了点，但妹妹的幸福比什么都重要。”

儿子的最后一句话，让寒仲文接受了路家的提亲。

是啊，不管女儿嫁给什么人家，她能幸福才是晨重要的。

“……路老太太在聚贤楼私下与你家四姑娘相见时，送了她两瓶乌梅汁，她出事前，让你回娄家，就是为了去拿这两瓶乌梅汁，顺道让你稍带西瓜，给路老太太，我说的可对？”

说完这番话，坐在路府偏厅里的寒招财，看向坐在她面前的桂婶。

想起那自小带大的孩子，桂婶拿着绢帕拭着泪，一边点着头，这件事只有她和四姑娘才知道，她不得不相信她先前所说的话。

“没错，她希望我能替她找出害死她的真凶。不瞒您说，那晚杀死她的人已经被抓进官府，他也指出幕后的主使者，可那幕后主使之人十分狡猾，抵赖不认，所以我才请您过来，想问问您知不知道，那人究竟是为何要咒她于死地？”

桂婶闻言一怔，想起这两日城里的传言，神色激动的站起身，“那买凶害死四姑娘的幕后主使，难道真是二少爷？”

“那杀手是如此供称。”寒招财原本不想将桂婶牵连进这事里，但如今官府以罪证不足为由，迟迟不拿娄梓纲问罪，无奈之下，她才想到娄竹心最信任的奶娘桂婶，也许娄竹心生前曾告诉过她什么事。

为了取信于桂婶，她只好佯称娄竹心托梦给她。

“定是他、定是他！”似是想起什么，桂婶咬牙切齿的揪紧手里的绢帕，“那件事四姑娘一句话都不敢说，他竟然还是不肯放过她！”

“四姑娘可是得知了他什么秘密？”寒招财连忙追问。

桂婶颔首，向她道出那件不可告人的丑事。

“娄家后院种了几株杏花，四姑娘有一日自个儿到后院去摘花，在那儿不慎掉了只珠珍耳环。她一路找着，来到后门边，后门附近就是摆放物什的一座库房，侧边有扇窗子，窗子是关着的，但窗纸有小小的破洞，她隐约听见里头好似有声音传来。一时好奇之下，遂往那破洞觑了眼，发现二少爷正和老爷的一个姨娘在行淫乱之事。四姑娘惊得轻呼一声，里头的人似是听到动静，胡乱穿衣就要出来，四姑娘一慌之下，连忙离开那儿。”当时姑娘回来后，吓得脸色发白，她担忧追问，四姑娘才把这事私下告诉了她。

听到这里，寒招财已经得知接下来的事了，“后来你们二少爷是不是去逼问四姑娘，当时是不是看见了什么？”

桂婶有些奇怪她怎么知道此事，答道，“没错。”

“是不是还有另外一人，也去问了四姑娘这件事？那人是谁？”

桂婶很讶异，没想到她连这事都知道，“四姑娘连这事也托梦告诉你了？但怎没一并告诉您是谁？”

寒招财含糊的说：“四姑娘托梦给我那时，有些事没说得很清楚。”

听她这么解释，桂婶也没再多想，说道：“那人是大少爷。”当时大少爷和二少爷先后来找四姑娘逼问那件事时，都把下人遣了出去，但她与四姑娘情同母女，这事四姑娘也没瞒着她。

“原来是他啊。”娄梓修说不定早就发觉娄梓纲与父亲侍妾有染之事，但他不愿做坏人揭穿此事，而想假借他人之手，故而才会找上娄竹心。

面对这位忠心耿耿的奶娘，寒招财将赖川在牢里招供的话，一五一十告诉她。

听完，桂婶满脸悲愤之色，“所以压根就不是那赖川挟怨报复，而故意诬指他！”下一瞬，她霍地站起身，似是下了什么决定，“多谢寒姑娘告诉我这些事，我这就去为四姑娘报仇。”

寒招财吃了一惊，连忙拦住她，“桂婶，你别冲动。”

揭露娄梓纲与伍姨娘私通之人，娄梓修还来不及安排，此事就在他措手不及之下被揭发了来——已离开的桂婶又再回到娄府，求见娄德山，当着他的面说出娄梓纲与伍姨娘私通之事。

“二少爷必是担心四姑娘会将这事告诉老爷，所以才买凶杀害她，老爷，求您要替四姑娘作主，不能让她就这么被人害死。”桂婶跪在地上，哭得泪流满面。

乍闻此事，娄德山又惊又怒，“你莫要胡言乱语，梓纲岂会做出这种事来？”

“那赖川谁不攀扯，为何偏指认二少爷，难道老爷就没有怀疑过吗？”

“那是他挟怨报复，才诬指梓纲。”娄德山替儿子说了句。

“您怎么不问问亲自审问赖川的杨捕头，看他是真的在诬指二少爷，还是二少为脱罪而反咬他？别的不说，二少爷私通伍姨娘之事，大少爷似乎也知情，不信您召他来一问便知。二少爷不顾人伦，与庶母通奸，您还要护着这样的不肖子吗？”

“这事我自会查问清禁，倘若让我得知你存心污蔑二少爷，纵使你是竹心的奶娘，我也饶不了你！”娄德山脸色铁青的说出重话。

“老爷，我敢对天发誓，我所说的若有一句假话，就不得好死。”桂婶抬手立下毒誓。

娄德山沉着脸，让人将桂婶带下去看守着。

倘若她所说的事是假的，他自是饶不了她，但如若她所言为真，他就更不能让她活着离开娄家。

这样的丑事一旦传出去，他娄家的脸面岂不丢光了。

不久，娄梓修被叫到书房来，一进来，便见娄德山脸色阴沉得骇人。

“爹。”他谨慎的唤了声，思忖是什么事，竟惹得父亲如此震怒。

坐在案桌前的娄德山，开口便质问长子，“我问你，你是不是知道梓纲与伍姨娘之间的事？”

闻言，猝不及防的娄梓修露出惊讶之色。

见状，娄德山也用不着再追问下去，怒摔了桌上的一个玉狮纸镇。“这个畜生！”

娄梓修飞快寻思父亲是如何得知此事。

“你早知道这事为何不来告诉我？”娄德山勃然大怒的责问长子。

娄梓修垂下眼，低声答道：“二弟是你唯一的嫡子，孩儿担心说出此事，会坏了你和二弟的父子之情。”
content_en:
"The old man didn't talk much, and he treated me and my cousin well. Before I came back, he even gave me some pointers on how to do business. After he learned that I wanted to go overseas to see the world, he also said that he could introduce me to an experienced and reliable maritime businessman..."

Hearing this, Mrs. Kong twisted her son's ears and said, "You kid still wants to go to sea and seek death. Your mother has not agreed to this. You are not allowed to go to me."

Han Defu rubbed his ears and hurriedly explained, "Hey, mother, sea ships are now extremely strong. Besides, Mr. Lu said that the sea merchants are experienced and will not be in danger. I should go out and explore while I am young so that I can gain experience."

Han Zhongwen nodded and said a few words for his son, "Defu is right. When the child is older, we cannot keep him locked up in this hill. It is also good to let him go out and see the world."

Seeing her husband speak, Mrs. Kong glanced at her son, and then asked, "Besides Mr. Lu and Mr. Lu, who else is there in the Lu family?"

"There are not many members of the Lu family. Apart from Mr. Lu and Lu Wanfeng, there is also a mother in the family. She is also a kind and kind person. She is very painful to us. They are like grandparents and have endless things to talk about every day."

After listening to what his son said, Han Zhongwen's expression softened a lot.

Kong was very satisfied, "So, the population of this family is simple, and they will be very good at attracting wealth to us."

Han Defu nodded, "Yeah, originally I didn't agree with recruiting money to marry into the Lu family, but after living there for two days, I felt that it was not a bad thing for my sister to marry into the Lu family. Although it is a bit far away from our Xinghua Village, my sister's happiness is more important than anything else."

His son's last words made Han Zhongwen accept the Lu family's marriage proposal.

Yes, no matter what family your daughter marries, her happiness is what is most important.

"... When Mrs. Lu met the fourth girl of your family in private at Juxian Building, she gave her two bottles of black plum juice. Before her accident, she asked you to go back to Lou's house just to get these two bottles of black plum juice. On the way, she asked you to bring some watermelon for Mrs. Lu. Am I right?"

After saying these words, Han Zhaocai, who was sitting in the side hall of Lu Mansion, looked at Aunt Gui who was sitting in front of her.

Thinking of the child she had brought up since childhood, Aunt Gui wiped her tears with a silk handkerchief and nodded. Only she and the fourth girl knew about this, so she had to believe what she said before.

"Yes, she hopes that I can find the real culprit who killed her for her. To be honest, the person who killed her that night has been arrested in the government. He also pointed out the person behind the scenes, but the person behind the scenes is very cunning and refuses to admit it. That's why I invited you here to ask if you know why that person wanted to curse her to death?"

Aunt Gui was startled when she heard this. She thought of the rumors in the city in the past two days and stood up with excitement. "Is the person behind the murder of the fourth girl really the second young master?"

"That's what the killer confessed." Han Zhaocai originally didn't want to involve Aunt Gui in this matter, but now the government has been slow to interrogate Lou Zigang because of insufficient evidence. In desperation, she thought of Lou Zhuxin's most trusted nanny, Aunt Gui, and maybe Lou Zhuxin had told her something before his death.

In order to win Aunt Gui's trust, she had to pretend to be Lou Zhu and entrust her with a dream.

"It must be him, it must be him!" As if remembering something, Aunt Gui gritted her teeth and clenched the silk handkerchief in her hand, "The fourth girl didn't dare to say a word about that matter, and he still refused to let her go!"

"What secret did the fourth girl learn about him?" Han Zhaocai asked quickly.

Aunt Gui nodded and told her the unspeakable scandal.

"There were several apricot flowers planted in the backyard of Lou's family. One day, the fourth girl went to the backyard to pick flowers and accidentally dropped a pearl earring. She searched all the way and came to the back door. Near the back door was a warehouse with items. There was a window on the side. The window was closed, but there were small holes in the window paper. She vaguely heard a sound coming from inside. She was curious for a moment.Then he glanced at the hole and found that the second young master was having an affair with one of the master's aunts.The fourth girl screamed in surprise. The people inside seemed to have heard the noise and were about to get dressed randomly. The fourth girl panicked and left there quickly."When the girl came back, her face turned pale with fear. She asked worriedly, and the fourth girl told her in private.

Hearing this, Han Zhaocai already knew what happened next, "Later, did your second young master go and ask the fourth girl if you saw anything at that time?"

Aunt Gui was a little surprised how she knew about this, and replied, "That's right."

"Is there another person who also asked the fourth girl about this matter? Who is that person?"

Aunt Gui was surprised. She didn't expect that she even knew this. "The fourth girl even told you this in a dream? But why didn't she also tell you who she was?"

Han Zhaocai said vaguely: "When the fourth girl entrusted me with her dream, there were some things that I didn't explain clearly."

After hearing her explanation, Aunt Gui didn't think much about it and said, "That person is the eldest young master." At that time, when the eldest young master and the second young master came to the fourth girl to ask about the incident, they both sent their servants out. However, she and the fourth girl were like mother and daughter, and the fourth girl did not hide this from her.

"It turns out it's him." Lou Zixiu might have discovered that Lou Zigang was having an affair with his father's concubine, but he didn't want to be a bad guy and exposed the matter, and wanted to use someone else's help, so he approached Lou Zhuxin.

Facing this loyal nanny, Han Zhaocai told her everything Lai Chuan had confessed in prison.

After hearing this, Aunt Gui's face was full of grief and anger, "So it's not that Lai Chuan was seeking revenge at all, but deliberately falsely accused him!" The next moment, she stood up suddenly, as if she had made some decision, "Thank you Miss Han for telling me these things, I will go and avenge the fourth girl."

Han Zhaocai was taken aback and stopped her quickly, "Aunt Gui, don't be impulsive."

The person who exposed the affair between Lou Zigang and Aunt Wu, Lou Zixiu had no time to arrange it, and the matter was revealed by surprise - Aunt Gui, who had left, returned to the Lou Mansion, asked to see Lou Deshan, and told him about the affair between Lou Zigang and Aunt Wu in front of him.

"The second young master must be worried that the fourth girl will tell the master about this, so he hired a murderer to kill her. Master, please make the decision for the fourth miss. You cannot let her be killed like this." Aunt Gui knelt on the ground, crying with tears streaming down her face.

When he first heard about this, Lou Deshan was shocked and angry, "Don't talk nonsense. How could Zigang do such a thing?"

"Then why did Lai Chuan choose to identify the second young master if he didn't argue? Didn't the master have any doubts?"

"That's why he falsely accused Zigang out of revenge." Lou Deshan said on behalf of his son.

"Why don't you ask Mr. Yang, who personally interrogated Lai Chuan, to see if he is really falsely accusing the second young master, or is the second young master trying to get away with it? If nothing else, the eldest young master seems to know about the second young master's affair with Aunt Wu. If you don't believe it, you can find out just by calling him. The second young master has no regard for human relations and has committed adultery with his concubine. Do you still want to protect such an unscrupulous son?"

"I will investigate this matter. If I find out that you are deliberately slandering the second young master, even if you are Zhu Xin's nanny, I will not spare you!" Lou Deshan said sternly with a livid face.

"Master, I dare to swear to God, if there is a lie in what I say, I will die badly." Aunt Gui raised her hand and made a poisonous oath.

Lou Deshan looked solemn and asked people to take Aunt Gui down to guard her.

If what she said was false, he would not be able to spare her, but if what she said was true, he would not be able to let her leave the Lou family alive.

Once such a scandal spreads out, the Lou family's face will be lost.

Soon, Lou Zixiu was called to the study. As soon as he came in, he saw Lou Deshan's face was frighteningly gloomy.

"Dad." He called out cautiously, thinking about what could have made his father so angry.

Lou Deshan, who was sitting at the desk, asked his eldest son, "Let me ask you, do you know what happened between Zigang and Aunt Wu?"

Hearing this, Lou Zixiu was caught off guard and showed surprise.

Seeing this, Lou Deshan didn't need to ask any more questions and angrily threw a jade lion paperweight on the table."This beast!"

Lou Zixiu quickly wondered how his father knew about this.

"You knew this earlier, why didn't you come and tell me?" Lou Deshan asked his eldest son angrily.

Lou Zixiu lowered his eyes and replied in a low voice: "The second brother is your only legitimate son. I am worried that telling this will ruin the father-son relationship between you and the second brother."
